key.name: history-retention-days
key.description: Days a notification stays in the notification centre, also across restarts of the shell. 0 keeps notifications only until the shell restarts.

key.name: history-limit
key.description: Maximum number of notifications kept in the notification centre.

key.name: sounds-enabled
key.description: Play a sound when a notification arrives, for apps that allow sounds.

key.name: sound-name
key.description: Sound theme name played for notifications that do not name their own sound.

key.name: sound-command
key.description: Command that plays a sound file, given as its last argument. Empty picks pw-play, paplay or canberra-gtk-play, whichever exists.

key.name: lock-screen-enabled
key.description: Show notifications on the lock screen, following the setting of each app.

key.name: known-applications
key.description: Keys of the apps that have sent notifications, listed in Settings.

key.name: focus-mode
key.description: Focus mode turned on by the Do Not Disturb switch and the quick settings tile.

key.name: focus-until
key.description: Unix time when the manually turned on Focus mode ends, 0 to keep it on until turned off.

key.name: display-name
key.description: Name the app used in its last notification.

key.name: icon
key.description: Icon the app used in its last notification.

key.name: enabled
key.description: Whether the app may show notifications.

key.name: show-banners
key.description: Show a banner on screen when a notification arrives.

key.name: sounds
key.description: Play a sound when a notification arrives.

key.name: lock-screen
key.description: Show notifications on the lock screen with their content, without it, or not at all.

key.name: priority
key.description: Time-sensitive notifications break through Focus modes that allow them.

key.name: grouping
key.description: Stack the notifications of the app together, or show each one on its own.

key.name: history-enabled
key.description: Remember copied text and images, opened with Super+V.

key.name: history-limit
key.description: Maximum number of items kept, pinned items excluded.

key.name: paste-on-select
key.description: Paste the chosen item into the focused app instead of only copying it.
